description: Offered the misheard line, and did not take it outside.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Named the price, the thumb, and the carrier's day.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Stayed on the floor, near the end of the loaf.
name: Gib

description: Ate, and did not offer to carry the letter.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Stood behind the halberds and gave the responses. He did not speak to you.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Read the heads and stopped when the glass was done.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Stopped the line, and left the sheet where it was.
name: William Shakespeare
